provenance.purpose: Line-search confound control (Codex P2 on PR #985): the May 2026 breach run predates the Armijo->Hager-Zhang default flip that landed in the same commit (029f4fe) as the probe script, so the May line search is unrecorded and plausibly Armijo, while the 2026-09-12 rerun used the HZ default. This run pins line_search_method='armijo' on the same commit/seed/warm-start as the HZ rerun; everything else is byte-identical (the SU warmstart energy reproduces the HZ run's -0.22540003330846212 exactly).
provenance.verdict: Floor HOLDS under Armijo: E=-0.39113 vs floor -0.43752 (delta +4.64e-2); optimizer converged (line search alpha=0 at step 22), not budget-truncated. Both line searches clear the floor on current main while the May run breached it, so the breach belonged to the pre-fix CTM code, not the line-search choice. Armijo's deeper-than-HZ energy (-0.3911 vs -0.3706, same 30-step budget) is an optimizer-budget effect within the physical band, not a discrepancy.
